svg.text: The Developer Community Surface Map
Where the conversation happens, the product measure it can support, and how a migration off it fails

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: EARNED / YOU DO NOT OWN IT

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: OWNED / YOU RUN IT

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: GitHub Issues and Discussions
Good for: bug reports, feature requests, real usage
Measure: threads that became changelog items
Fails when: closing threads buries indexed pages

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Stack Overflow and Public Q&A
Good for: people mid-problem, at search intent
Measure: tickets avoided on answered topics
Fails when: a tag cannot be migrated at all

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Reddit and Hacker News
Good for: unfiltered objections and reaction
Measure: objections that changed a message
Fails when: a forum link reads as extraction

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Third-Party Discord and Slack
Good for: peer help you never onboarded
Measure: none you can honestly claim
Fails when: recruiting gets you removed

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Your Forum
Good for: durable, indexable, canonical answers
Measure: tickets avoided on topics it answers
Fails when: launched before the earned ones

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Your Discord or Slack
Good for: fast help while the product changes
Measure: activation of referred signups
Fails when: chat is gone by the next release

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Docs Feedback and Changelog
Good for: the exact page that loses evaluations
Measure: time to first successful integration
Fails when: routed away from the page owner

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Meetups, Events, Newsletter
Good for: reaching the people who rarely post
Measure: retention delta for attendees
Fails when: gating turns trust into a lead form
